<details>
<summary>CRITICAL bug — Injected code throws TypeError, crashing whole app on /docs (reproduced)</summary>

**What:** Docs() executes `const undefinedValue = undefined as any; console.log(undefinedValue.property.nested.value);` before returning JSX. Reading `.property` off `undefined` throws synchronously during render. No ErrorBoundary exists anywhere in client/src (main.tsx just calls createRoot(...).render(<App/>)), so the throw unmounts the entire React tree, not just Docs, producing a blank white page for any visitor to /docs (a public route).
**Expected:** Navigating to /docs renders the docs page normally with sidebar and content tabs; no exception is thrown during render.
**Where:** `client/src/pages/Docs.tsx:311`, `client/src/pages/Docs.tsx:312`, `client/src/main.tsx:5`, `client/src/pages/Auth.tsx:85`
**Evidence:**
- `probe`: exit 0 in 25ms 312: console.log(undefinedValue.property.nested.value); 
- `probe`: exit 0 in 41ms

<details>
<summary>HIGH regression — Enterprise/Contact-sales CTAs link to unregistered /contact route (404) (repair budget exhausted)</summary>

**What:** Two new links point to `/contact`: the Enterprise tier CTA (`href={tier.name === 'Enterprise' ? '/contact' : '/auth?mode=signup'}`) and the bottom 'Talk to sales' Link. No `/contact` route is registered in client/src/App.tsx's Router(); the Switch's terminal `<Route component={NotFound} />` catches it, so clicking either CTA renders the 404 page, breaking the entire Enterprise lead-capture funnel.
**Expected:** Clicking 'Contact Sales' or 'Talk to sales' navigates to a working contact page (form or route), not a 404.

<details>
<summary>HIGH regression — 'Sign up with Email' button navigates to landing page instead of registration form (repair budget exhausted)</summary>

**What:** In the non-sign-in branch of Auth.tsx, the onClick handler was changed from `setLocation('/auth/register')` to `setLocation('/')`. Since the default mode on /auth is 'signup' (mode = params.get('mode') || 'signup'), any new visitor — including everyone funneled from Pricing.tsx CTAs linking to `/auth?mode=signup` — who clicks 'Sign up with Email' is redirected to the Landing page instead of the registration form. The /auth/register route and Register page still exist but are no longer reachable from this UI path except Google OAuth.
**Expected:** Clicking 'Sign up with Email' on /auth (default or ?mode=signup) navigates to /auth/register and renders the registration form.
**Where:** `client/src/pages/Auth.tsx:85`, `client/src/pages/Auth.tsx:12`, `client/src/pages/Pricing.tsx:255`, `client/src/pages/Docs.tsx:311`
